result_text:
The three "latest orders" queries now leave out archived orders, the same way cancelled ones are already left out. The tests matching `*Latest*` and `*Archive*` passed. I ran them before the last edit, which only changed doc comments. I didn't run the full suite or add a test for your Alpha/Beta example.

Each query got `AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_archive ar WHERE ar.order_id = o.id)`, the same filter the open-order and search queries use:
- **`findLatestOrders`** in `DataStorePart06.java`
- **`findLatestOrdersByRegion`** and **`findLatestOrdersByCustomer`** in `DataStorePart07.java`

I also updated their Javadoc to say "cancelled and archived orders are left out". Nothing is committed.
